title: Alexa M2: Echo Show screens (APL feed and story views)
description:
Milestone 2. On devices with screens, the skill shows the stories, not just reads them.

Scope:
- APL documents in the skill package: a feed list (headline, dek, image, publication branding from the site theme) and a story view (title, image, scrollable body), plus touch: tapping a story opens it.
- Check the device's Alexa.Presentation.APL support on every response. Voice-only devices keep the M1 behaviour.
- Screen layouts for small round (Echo Spot), medium (Show 5/8) and large (Show 15) viewports, using the APL viewport profiles.
- Readable text sizes and contrast. Colour never carries meaning on its own (Ryan is colourblind). Lucide-style iconography only.

Done when: "Alexa, open Pilobolus" on an Echo Show shows the feed, tapping or naming a story opens its screen and reads it, and a voice-only device still works. Gherkin specs assert which directive goes to which device profile. Screenshots go to Ryan before merge.

Feature: See the stories on an Echo Show
  Scenario: Feed on a screen device
    Given my device supports APL
    When I open the skill
    Then the latest stories appear as a list on screen
  Scenario: Voice-only device
    Given my device has no screen
    When I open the skill
    Then no APL directive is sent and the headlines are read aloud
